events.title: Moderate Rain Detected
events.teaser: Radar shows moderate rain moving east. Expect wet roads and reduced visibility in the immediate area.

events.title: Light Snowfall Advisory
events.teaser: Light snow flurries detected by radar. Accumulation expected to be minimal, but slick spots possible on elevated surfaces.

events.title: Thunderstorm Activity West
events.teaser: Isolated thunderstorm cells forming to the west. Expect lightning and brief heavy downpours. Seek shelter indoors.

events.title: Patchy Fog Formation
events.teaser: Radar indicates areas of dense fog developing, particularly near water bodies. Visibility may drop rapidly. Use low beams.

events.title: Wind Shear Alert North
events.teaser: Low-level wind shear detected. Potential for sudden changes in wind speed and direction. Caution advised for aviation.

events.title: Heavy Rain Warning
events.teaser: Intense rainfall detected moving into the area. Risk of localized flooding and very poor visibility. Avoid unnecessary travel.

events.title: Hail Potential East
events.teaser: Radar suggests potential for small hail within strong thunderstorm cells. Protect vehicles and seek sturdy shelter immediately.

events.title: Light Rain Showers
events.teaser: Scattered light rain showers passing through. Minimal impact expected, but roads may become slightly damp.

events.title: Developing Snow Squalls
events.teaser: Radar shows developing snow squalls. Rapid drops in visibility and sudden accumulation possible. Drive with extreme caution.

events.title: Isolated Thunderstorm
events.teaser: An isolated thunderstorm is currently overhead. Expect heavy rain, lightning, and strong wind gusts. Stay indoors.

events.title: Dense Fog Advisory
events.teaser: Widespread dense fog reported by radar. Visibility is severely reduced to less than a quarter mile. Travel is not recommended.

events.title: Moderate Snowfall
events.teaser: Moderate snowfall continues. Roads are becoming snow-covered and slippery. Allow extra time for travel and maintain distance.

events.title: Strong Wind Gusts
events.teaser: Radar indicates strong wind gusts associated with a passing front. Secure loose outdoor objects and be aware of falling debris.
